data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in Canada, my top recommendation would be **Stripe or Shopify Payments**, depending on which platform you're using.

You want a processor that offers\:

- Competitive transaction fees.
- No expensive monthly processing contract.
- Easy integration with your online store.
- Visa, Mastercard, American Express and digital wallets.
- Reliable payouts to your Canadian bank account.
- Fraud protection and chargeback management.

## My top 5 payment processors

| Processor | Best for | My verdict |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Stripe | Independent online stores | (Best overall) |
| Shopify Payments | Shopify stores | (Best for Shopify) |
| PayPal | Customer payment flexibility | Great secondary option |
| Square | Online and in-person sales | Great for small retailers |
| Helcim | Growing Canadian businesses | Worth comparing on fees |


### 1\. Stripe

![Startup People | Stripe](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/FHBAP3wuWYGgNzMx3x8hPe2Fc7azbkU0AM_mBYs_madx1He_NSVgZxrUntRLrTlfM-FokllQgfFwL9d41sRcWmwiwsS8KER79_js_ir_sKMMXek2ApVAcwnNY3e6SCtQOsiE86phcynlJWXG-cCagzIV7FjTrEX6r_uuMNUx8OxjbWSruuB9KVKTkvlFLNTI?purpose=fullsize)

**Best overall for independent stores**

- Easy integration with WooCommerce and other platforms.
- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Supports recurring payments and international customers.
- Strong developer tools.
- Canadian domestic card pricing is generally around 2.9% + C\$0.30.
  
  [Canadian pricing](https://stripe.com/ca/pricing)

### 2\. Shopify Payments

![What Is Shopify Payments? Why Every Shopify Store Should Use It
 – NextSky](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/owj8VQHYMqG0lc8_SsSMfZk2uKjMqTT0Zop7pXmJVuy_BBUP5YpcAFMKYLZeHLK_02osfqG7zw-aeUNbtr0x50j6nLEMX2Oec2w7RKVAKnFaKH4I0QjYgY8K48COPeCJQDjB7TKiPWaAWlnV6C-EOv8A8IZkLTzbM_8YVVh88O4OqRsm3B6I6EHi8Cbl1tRE?purpose=fullsize)

**Best if you use Shopify**

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway setup.
- Supports major cards and Shop Pay.
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.
  
  [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

### 3\. PayPal

![PayPal Data Engineer Interview Guide: Process, Tips & Sample Questions (2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/f0uRaTYwCkNonVHhCf9KOTEsVnKlm9vvkNkLP-NC6CJKaxFB8F1HmrcbukmpLY611LX5Y93PEbagy1tQey-5apWDqbD9c6blP1TQ7MwEmDOj_cRP3s85_4cgV3W1x6Qbn1kdiUTQ0O5_78RzJpDEHd1ZeXSgH84eTY8Jums_ROnoO0E03vBGeB5VkqESBnwA?purpose=fullsize)

**Best as an additional payment option**

- Many customers already trust it.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance.
- Offers additional checkout flexibility.
- Fees can be higher than standard card processing.
  
  [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

### What I would choose

For a new small online store, I'd start with Stripe or Shopify Payments and add PayPal as another checkout option.

You don't need an expensive enterprise payment processor when you're just starting.

## Three questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more precise recommendation if I know\:

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**

---

**2\. Expected monthly sales?**

---

**3\. Where are most of your customers?**

[Get my recommendation]

I'll use those answers to identify the best processor and help you minimize transaction fees while keeping checkout convenient for customers.
